entries.detail: Evidence lookup, claim tables, reason strings; verdict per needed capability executes mncs.harness.eligibility.v1::capability_eligible via mncs_exec.capability_eligible.
Integer budget/availability verdict executes mncs.harness.eligibility.v1::resource_gate via mncs_exec.resource_gate; facts contract unchanged.
Granted-AND-covered verdict executes mncs.harness.atlas.v1::tool_admission via mncs_exec.tool_admission; reason text host-side.
mncs/harness_routing.mncs executed via mncs_exec on every route.
mncs/harness_routing.mncs needs_coder executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_policy.mncs executed via mncs_exec; host encodes shell/python/git/path observations.
mncs/harness_policy.mncs evaluate_write executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_verdict.mncs generic combine_all<N> over combine4/combine8 envelopes executed; host chunks envelopes.
mncs/harness_atlas.mncs generic fold_all<4> over fold4 envelope + fold_pair/dispatch_gate/tool_admission executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_pins.mncs shape table + fail-closed admission + is_exact_pin executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_fabric.mncs precedence + dispatch gate executed via mncs_exec.
Generic fold_readiness<N> over concrete fold4/fold8 envelopes executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_eligibility.mncs capability/resource/capability-source/residency-admit gates executed via mncs_exec.
Primary classification + coder chain execute mncs.harness.routing.v1::classify_route/::needs_coder via mncs_exec.primary_role/needs_coder; availability mapping host-side.
Pin admission executes mncs.harness.pins.v1::admit_placement via mncs_exec.admit_placement; reason prefixes host-side.
Overall verdict executes mncs.harness.readiness.v1::fold4/::fold8 envelopes via mncs_exec.fold_readiness; warnings stay host-side.
Classification + dispatch gate execute mncs.harness.fabric.v1::classify_fabric/::dispatch_allowed via mncs_exec; version parsing host-side.
Pin shape table executes mncs.harness.pins.v1::pin_fields_valid via mncs_exec.pin_fields_valid; string content checks host-side.
Command ordering executes mncs.harness.policy.v1::evaluate_command via mncs_exec.command_reason; lexing/paths host-side.
Write decision executes mncs.harness.policy.v1::evaluate_write via mncs_exec.write_allowed.
Verification acceptance folds through mncs.harness.verdict.v1::combine8/::combine4/::is_decided via mncs_exec.combine/verdict_decided; subprocess checks host-side.
Duplicate-decision fold executes mncs.harness.atlas.v1::fold4 via mncs_exec.fold; reasons/outstanding host-side.
Final target comparison executes mncs.harness.atlas.v1::dispatch_gate via mncs_exec.dispatch_gate; freshness/signature host-side.
Free-form task text tokenization, regex scans, word counts need strings.
Lane scores, thresholds, temperature/top_p need floats.
Shell lexing, allowlist tables, path resolution are string/FS effects.
py_compile/bash/JSON/TOML/test subprocess execution is a process effect.
Ed25519 issuance verification and SHA-256 canonical digests need crypto.
Freshness windows and session echo need a clock.
Mode/field string content (length, control chars) needs strings.
Plain dataclasses transported across the host boundary.
PEP-440 parsing and capability-name tables are string operations.
Transport, heartbeats, session state are network effects.
Layer probing builds stringly-typed dicts over transports.
Age arithmetic and timeouts need a clock.
Probe subprocesses and Ollama HTTP are process/network effects.
Multi-turn loop, spawning, cancellation need concurrency.
Exact-pin predicate executes mncs.harness.pins.v1::is_exact_pin via mncs_exec; progress branch only.
Per-step route/policy/verdict choices execute kernels via mncs_exec through tools/router.
Handler dispatch, truncation, subprocess tools are process effects.
Inventory fetch, claims, sizes are transport/dict operations.
Frozen artifact loading, executor subprocess, ABI codec: the adapter itself.
Canonical mncs_exec entrypoints; each one executes its kernel through mncs_runtime.call and fails closed. No Python fallback exists.
TOML load/merge and env interpolation need structured text.
Timestamps, durations, and SQLite persistence need clock + storage.
Terminal event loop and rendering are TTY effects.
Ollama HTTP client is a network effect.
Provider dispatch over HTTP/subprocess transports.
MCP transport, JSON envelopes, SQLite records are I/O effects.
Admission precedence executes mncs.harness.policy.v1::publication_gate via mncs_exec; Commons transport/translation host-side.
Controller/bridge transports are network effects.
Inventory-source selection executes mncs.harness.eligibility.v1::capability_source via mncs_exec; string matching/sorting/paths host-side.

Row availability is string-identity set membership over live inventory plus delegation to fabric_session.resolve (external); no bounded numeric/threshold decision exists to move (strings blocked by HARNESS-PRESSURE-001).
Git probing, path inspection, JSON emission are process/FS effects.
Completeness over string identities needs text + digests.
Git digests, canonical JSON, clock strings are process/crypto/time effects.
Gap detection over string identities needs text.
Prompt templates are string construction.
Score arithmetic needs floats; retained as compatibility-only.
Live model verification over subprocess/HTTP transports.
Claim/size table lookups over string-keyed dicts.
JSONL evidence store read/write is an FS effect.
Subcommand dispatch, approval interaction, output rendering.
Entry-point shims delegating to cli modules.
JSON-RPC stdio transport to the extension host.
Controller transports, worker spawning, polling loops.
Trust-store file I/O and metadata are FS effects.
Cloud commissioning over APIs; purpose labels are frozen wire strings.
Breakaway provisioning over transports.
Worker inventory file polling and JSON parsing.
Profile files, state paths, worker table I/O.
Breakaway/inventory profile variants; same I/O shape.
Inventory-backed profile resolution over files.
Worker-side tool shims over transports.
Test fixtures and fakes for distributed tests.
Model tag tables and inventory mapping.
Routing evaluation scenarios driving the product path.
Scenario harness driving product paths in tests.
Actor provenance construction over string identities.
Windows worker launcher over process effects.
Canonical identity constants.
Interpreter entry point.
Test-only agreement oracle + corpus loader; never imported from src/.
Ready/configured/record precedence executes mncs.harness.policy.v1::publication_gate via mncs_exec.publication_gate; error codes mapped host-side.
